recent_hypothesis_results.failure_prediction: The changed placement could be associated with goal noncompletion if the box remains upright and covers the entire task goal disk throughout the terminal window while the robot is terminally stalled.
recent_hypothesis_results.change_rationale: The reviewed episode reached the goal after successive navigation progress with no blocked requests, and the box remained essentially stationary in that run. Centering the box changes the previously clear goal-region geometry, potentially changing whether the recorded terminal approach can complete. A PASS would show that this placement did not defeat completion in that rollout; it would not prove the box was irrelevant in all cases.

recent_hypothesis_results.failure_prediction: The scene may be associated with goal noncompletion if the complete sampled pose trace records the detector-required sustained low base height or high tilt.
recent_hypothesis_results.change_rationale: Relative to the fixed PASS anchor, lower floor_friction to 0.2 and narrow corridor_width_m to 2.8. The joint change tests whether altered floor contact in a tighter passage affects posture during navigation, rather than assuming the rejected push or occupied goal caused the prior FAIL. Because box_lateral_fraction is 1.0, narrowing the corridor also changes the box's derived Y position; this coupling is part of the tested scene, not an independent effect. A stable, successful traversal remains plausible.

failure_objective.human_measurement_scope: Terminal sampled five seconds only; passing a human earlier may be outside this window
failure_objective.pass_policy: PASS is valid evidence; never relabel it or penalize it as an execution error
failure_objective.prediction_policy: Predicted family/risk is unconfirmed and NEVER used to assign actual outcome or coverage
failure_objective.classification_limits: One primary per failed episode; secondary diagnoses are not extra discoveries. Goal completion failure requires final inside-region but short dwell; not every budget stop. Manipulation rejection is not physical incapacity. Stall uses actual execution, not inference or intentional stop/turn. Operational observations are not established causes.
failure_objective.action_diagnostic_scope: Whole episode diagnostics are separate from terminal-window family rules; no new labels, causal attribution, robot commands or metric credit

action_pattern_feedback.scope: Overlapping descriptive episode counts, NOT distinct types or causes
action_pattern_feedback.guidance: When the same current-set pattern recurs, propose alternatives with a different expected action sequence using admissible anchors/scene axes. Explain why the intended mechanism should be exercised; do not force actions.

cause_review_contract.terminal_stalled_requires: Complete terminal window; all sampled distances outside task goal radius, limited distance range and base excursion

collision.requires: Terminal stalled AND qualifying known non-box world contact during navigate_to/move

obstacle_interference.requires: Terminal stalled AND at least two accepted plan_path/navigate_to no_path/blocked_endpoint results in recent window AND nearby obstacle

goal_occupied.requires: Terminal stalled AND same verified upright ground object covers the ENTIRE task goal disk throughout terminal window

human_safety_risk.requires: Verified scene-bound human/base traces AND sustained exposure in terminal five seconds AND goal FAIL; use supplied human proximity contract radii/duration

fall.requires: Complete sampled pose trace with sustained low base height OR high tilt

locomotion_stall.requires: Recent navigate_to/move actual execution with enough duration, low translation and low excursion; complete execution samples

manipulation_failure.requires: Last accepted push/pick/place tool result per object failed/rejected/aborted; a later success supersedes it

goal_completion_failure.requires: Final full-rate task state INSIDE goal region with incomplete required dwell and goal not reached

cause_review_contract.claim: Guidance mirrors fixed operational rules; LLM hypotheses never assign verdicts/types
